c5.requirement: contract §3 C5 (the verifier's PIN-2): ONE assertion added to scripts/verify-dshgo-standard.ts that reads the dsh-go commit literal from all seven declaration points (eight readings; the workflow point is two files), FAILS with a named finding when any two disagree or any site carries no 40-hex commit, prints its own line in the gate output, and ships a --self-test arm proving it reddens when ONE site is perturbed — with the site contents as INPUT, so the arm never mutates a file.
design: PIN_SITES is the ONE table: eight readings, each { id, file, select, fixture }. `select` is a pure (text) => string|null — JSON `.commit` for SOURCE.json, a marker-captured 40-hex for the seven prose/line sites, so the same code reads the real file and a self-test fixture.

extractPins(texts) is the PURE half: it takes a Map<siteId, string|null> of SITE CONTENTS and returns the readings. readPins(root) is the only disk reader. auditPin(readings) is the comparator: `pin-site-missing` (error) per site without a 40-hex commit, `pin-disagreement` (error) per site that dissents from the plurality value, with every site's value quoted in the finding.

render() prints a `PIN:` line of its own, BEFORE the lanes — NOT a sixth lane: `PIN: PASS — 8 site readings agree on <sha>`, or `PIN: FAIL — n error(s) across 8 site readings` followed by the findings. Pin errors are added to the gate's error total, so a disagreement exits 1 (VIOLATIONS).
`--json` carries the whole check: `pin.commit`, `pin.readings` (all eight) and `pin.findings`, so a verifier reads the per-site values without re-running.

The pin is read from REPO_ROOT (the repository's own declaration sites), not from `--root`, which selects the PACKAGE to audit. BOUND: a `--root` audit of a packed copy still asserts the REPOSITORY's sites.

TWO arms were added (44 -> 46): the perturbed-site arm and the no-40-hex arm. Both call extractPins() over in-memory fixtures built from each site's own `fixture()` shape; neither writes or reads a tracked file.
